book.name: Hibru
book.title: Hibru Quraŋ Moji Hibru yoŋore Quraŋ ruaya.

content: Morende soriŋ gio siŋaŋ qoruine sosowo oi ŋiŋigo botuyaŋuŋgone roosoe yaberu gio iŋi banimiŋ ore igodoŋ yabeegobeneŋ: Iŋoji ŋiŋigo minebobonoŋuŋ fukeru Anutuke maŋmoakoŋ eru gokiminde gio baku agiburaŋ ebeŋ ore joma yauŋine yauŋine oi Anuture ruaru oiji boji rigaega.
Iŋoyoŋunde maŋ mamanesu goineji oŋuakoŋ wiriine fukega. Ore eru ŋiŋigo qosorieku qanda paiineo tiŋtuŋ eegobi, oi soine beusembe paio enoreega.
Wiriine fukega ore iŋoyoŋunde agiburaŋ eru kufufuŋpuine yoŋore agiburaŋ oŋuakoŋ ke keririkeiŋ ore jomaji boji rigaega.
Moji tinabiŋe oi iŋoyoŋunde so biŋe qoqo eiŋyoŋ, Anutuji Aron oŋga teya, ore so iŋo oŋuakoŋ oŋga tega.
Ore so Kristoji oŋuakoŋ iŋoyoŋe soriŋ gio siŋaŋ qoruine fukeinde tinabiŋe oi iŋoyoŋunde so raugayayoŋ, Anutuji iŋi mitigaya,

content.text: “Goji nonde Made fukende nonji muŋambe gore Mama fukego.”

content: Buŋo ore so soriŋ gio siŋaŋ qorunoŋuŋ fukeya.
Buŋo oi akoŋ mime Biŋe Qurande mobeine mogo iŋi pega,

content.text: “Goji Melkisedek oŋuine soriŋ gio siŋaŋ fukeru damaŋ tatariine tomiri go ropemiŋ.”

content: Yesuji saki fuke moreŋgo goku oo damaŋine damaŋine oŋga wosiru sanaŋ qaŋqaŋine oŋgako jiŋo kuineji wakiko Anutu komegone bomukuiŋgo sanaŋgaya, oi weu teru goya. Weu teru goku Anutu araŋ baku buŋoinere rurumaŋgo rurua eku goya ore Anutuji oŋgawowosiine maneya.
Madeine fukeyayoŋ, Anutuji oi jibu joiserereŋ so kipeme paiineo ropeko maneru oo buŋo rerende fuŋne bofukeru mane sarigaya.
Oi maneru kuririine sosowo bofukeru seŋgiŋbaŋgiŋ tatariine tomiri gokiminde kukure Rauine fukeya. Ore eru ŋiŋigo iŋore mi reŋgaru gogobi, oi sosowo soine kure yareme seŋgiŋbaŋgiŋ bofukenimiŋ.
Rauine oi fukeko Anutuji oi Melkisedek oŋuine soriŋ gio siŋaŋ qoruine fukeiŋgo mitariru igodoŋgaya. Oŋu.
Mamanesinde foriji egu jibugainde siŋaŋ bobo buŋo
Buŋo oi soine jikigaru kokoine miku soguenobeŋyoŋ, ŋoŋoji buŋo maneru boyobenimiŋgo kubaŋjijiŋo eru tuturi egobi. Ore eru oi mitaniŋga ŋarekimiŋgo embiŋqombiŋ egobeneŋ.

Ŋoŋoji damaŋ joroine kufufuŋ raŋgbaŋine goku soine damaŋ yoo qaqaji fukeniminde so fukenobuŋyoŋ ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe Anuture buŋo koruŋ fuŋfuŋgaine oi moji ŋeŋeineo moke qaji ŋareiŋgo embimbiŋgaegobi. Ŋoŋoji quŋgaru Biŋe buŋo oi moŋ oŋuine noiŋgo maneegobi. Uqo sanaŋine oŋuine oi noiŋgo embimbiŋgaegobi.
Moji oi moŋ oŋuine noku goga, iŋoji jikigaru made gbio oŋuine fukega. Anuture jiŋoo posiine fukekiminde buŋo qaji ŋarebeŋyoŋ, iŋoji ore fuŋine so mane mukuru mo goga.

Made gbio oŋuine gogayoŋ, uqo sanaŋine oi ŋiŋigo mamaneyaŋunji sogueya, yoŋoji nonimiŋ ore eru pega. Ŋiŋigo Biŋe buŋo jijiki kegboreru gobi maŋ mamaneyaŋunji kerisie foreko soine afagaru mosi sosowo osoeru fiine eru sembene boroiŋ yaperu fiine boyobeegobi. Uqo sanaŋine oi yoŋore eru pega.
